definitions.explanation: Something that strongly calls to mind or vividly evokes an image of something else. Almost always used in the pattern 〜を{彷彿|ほうふつ}とさせる (to be reminiscent of) or 〜を{彷彿|ほうふつ}させる.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昭和|しょうわ}→昭和：28079_shouwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{彷彿|ほうふつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧{街並|まちな}み。
examples.english: A streetscape reminiscent of the Showa era.
That performance was reminiscent of his father in his younger days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧ローマ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{彷彿|ほうふつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{壮大|そうだい}→壮大：10900_soudai⟧な⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{魅了|みりょう}している→魅了する：19016_miryousuru⟧。
examples.english: The grand architecture, reminiscent of ancient Rome, captivates tourists.

notes:
{彷彿|ほうふつ} means to vividly evoke or call to mind something else. It is almost never used as a standalone word — it appears in fixed patterns.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{彷彿|ほうふつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧: to be reminiscent of ~, to evoke ~ (most common)
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{彷彿|ほうふつ}⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧: slightly less formal variant of the above

EXAMPLES OF USE:
- ⟦{昭和|しょうわ}→昭和：28079_shouwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{彷彿|ほうふつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧: reminiscent of the Showa era
- {若|わか}き⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{彷彿|ほうふつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧: evocative of one's younger days

REGISTER:
A literary, written expression. Common in reviews, essays, and descriptive journalism. Not typically used in casual speech — ⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}させる→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧ (to remind of) or 〜⟦みたい→みたい：10755_mitai⟧だ (like ~) are more natural alternatives in conversation.

WRITING:
The kanji {彷彿|ほうふつ} are rarely used outside this word. Sometimes written in hiragana as ほうふつ.
